resolution: Same deliverable as req_0984 (the user's additional Blockbench screenshots clarifying offset/direction semantics for loop cut). Captured into the loop-cut implementation: direction = the clicked face's normal axis first; offset default = half-size (centered) with raising it shrinking the clicked face's slab while interior slabs stay equal; Size Units vs Percent unit toggle. Implemented + tested under req_0984/0989.
